checks.name: Hash-verified owned bark and endgrain reproduce the opaque 1024px atlas exactly; no original pixels or masks enter the artwork.
The exact 52-vertex, 64-triangle log geometry retains UVs, normals and tangents. Both log scales have scoped side and end-island review; 165 other mesh consumers remain excluded.
HD 1024px and Balanced 512px albedo-only payloads pass native metadata and readback checks within the expanded 40-texture catalog.
Twelve Standard-material frames cover both log scales and candidates at 1080p/4K. Checks pass without shader errors or warnings; scene and global state are restored.
The exact original normal and tint are retained comparison controls. Coarse normal shading and clamped HDR highlights remain visible limitations, not companion-map or lighting approval.
No runtime binding, world, physics, representative-performance, authored-model or final-art stage is claimed.
